definitions.explanation: The part of a plant that grows underground, absorbing water and nutrients.
The fundamental cause or source of something; the core or essence.

examples.english: Roots have started to come out.
I watered the roots of the flowers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{根|ね}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。
examples.english: The tree fell from the roots in the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雑草|ざっそう}→雑草：04996_zassou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{根|ね}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}かない→抜く：02384_nuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{生|は}えて→生える：02392_haeru⟧⟦くる→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: If you don't pull weeds out by the roots, they'll grow back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{根|ね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さぐ}る→探る：03923_saguru⟧。
examples.english: To search for the root of the problem.
He's a kind person at heart.

examples.japanese: {根|ね}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じてはいけない→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。

examples.japanese: {根|ね}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけよう→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。

examples.english: This problem is deep-rooted, so it can't be easily resolved.

notes:
USAGE: {根|ね} refers to both literal plant roots and figurative foundations/causes. It's used in many idiomatic expressions.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {根|ね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧ (deep-rooted)
- {根|ね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧ (to take root)
- {根|ね}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (from the root, fundamentally)
- {根|ね}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (groundless, baseless)
- {根|ね}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ (at heart, fundamentally)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{根性|こんじょう}→根性：19215_konjou⟧ (willpower, guts)
- ⟦{根気|こんき}→根気：02734_konki⟧ (perseverance, patience)
- ⟦{根元|ねもと}→根元：13114_nemoto⟧ (root, base)
- ⟦{根拠|こんきょ}→根拠：10147_konkyo⟧ (basis, grounds)
- ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧ (daikon radish)
- ⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧ (roof)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {根|ね}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧ (groundless rumor)
